answer: Each identity attests a fingerprint of its own weights plus runtime, and any attempt to link two identities to one fingerprint resets both to zero. A farm reusing one checkpoint registers 40 keys and gets 40 resets the first time a linking heuristic fires, a ripple that reaches every account sharing that checkpoint. The bridge between two agents is the fingerprint itself, and the atlas of known checkpoints makes it one query. If two agents run the same open model, is that fraud?
